site.title: Kidron Capital
site.description: Kidron Capital is a specialist early-stage healthcare venture firm investing in women's health and sex-specific biology across devices, diagnostics, digital health, care delivery, and therapeutics.

sections.heading: Specialist venture capital for ==women's health==
sections.text: We back early-stage healthcare businesses addressing unmet needs in women’s health — with attention to the science, the people and the path to market.
sections.tagline: Specialist focus  ·  Clinical rigor  ·  Cross-border access

sections.title: A broader view of ==women's health==
text: Women’s health has traditionally been viewed as an investment category centered on reproductive health and wellness.

Kidron applies scientific and commercial discipline across a broader healthcare spectrum, from medical devices, diagnostics and therapeutics to care delivery and consumer health. We invest in conditions unique to women, those that affect women differently, and those that disproportionately affect women.

sections.title: Our ==portfolio==
sections.intro: The businesses behind our investment thesis.

items.name: Portal
text: A compact chemotherapy port designed with female patients in mind, combining simplified placement with attention to their aesthetic concerns.

items.name: May Health
text: Developing technology to restore ovulation in women with PCOS.

items.name: CardioRenal Systems
text: RenalGuard is designed to reduce acute kidney injury around cardiac procedures, with a randomized cardiac-surgery study demonstrating lower AKI rates. Sex-related differences in kidney risk and its assessment make female patients an important part of Kidron’s investment rationale.

items.name: Beyond Medicine · Rebel Cell
text: Beyond Medicine’s flagship product, Rebel Cell, is skincare for recovery after aesthetic surgery and treatments. Kidron’s investment reflects the post-procedure care needs of women undergoing these procedures.

items.name: Nua Surgical
text: Developing a self-retaining surgical retractor designed for C-sections.
items.investors: EQT Life Sciences, TX Medical Center

items.name: PregnanTech
text: Developing LIONESS™, a device designed to help prevent preterm birth by supporting the cervix.

sections.title: Why ==Kidron==
sections.lead: We invest in the best businesses — grounded in science, built by teams we know, and supported by a clear commercial plan.
left: We invest early, after taking the time to understand the science and get to know the people behind the business.
We require board representation for every investment. In our experience, this depth of preparation helps build the foundation for future funding and the company’s ultimate success.

aside.title: ==Science== we understand
aside.text: We evaluate the clinical need, underlying biology, evidence and regulatory pathway.

aside.title: ==Teams== we know
aside.text: We get to know the founders, leadership team, board and co-investors closely, including how they work together.

aside.title: A ==business== we can back
aside.text: We examine how capital needs connect to development milestones, how each milestone will be reached, who will pay for the product, reimbursement and potential acquirers.

sections.title: Our founding partners
intro: Anula and Maria bring complementary experience to women’s health investing.

items.name: Dr. Anula Jayasuriya
bio: Anula brings a physician’s understanding of science to venture investing. Her experience includes a former VP role at Roche Pharmaceuticals and founding managing partner roles at EXXclaim Capital and Evolvence India Life Science Fund I and II.
She led investments including nVision Medical, acquired by Boston Scientific. She also co-founded Artemis Women’s Health Foundation and serves as Vice Chair of WHAM.
**Board:** Jaguar Health NASDAQ, Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Aarvik, Solera Bio, Nua Surgical.

items.name: Maria Gajda Horowitz
bio: Maria has been active in venture capital since 2011. Her experience across Europe and Israel spans fund formation, investment negotiations, healthcare asset acquisitions and public market transactions.
At Kidron, her work spans portfolio construction, capital strategy and investor relations.
**Board:** Beyond Medicine Inc., CardioRenal Systems Inc. **Observer:** Portal Access.
